summary: Plan of w121 written (plan.md). r56, r64 and r65 are red at undefined steps, and the plugin refuses every run that collects only unaccepted scenarios. Change: scripts/work_items.py reads `group: guarantees` from spec/capabilities/<cap>.md. It refuses only when an accepted requirement is not guarantees, deselects every collected scenario otherwise (keeping non-scenario tests), and makes 'no tests ran' exit 0 for an all-guarantees work-item. The steps go in supervision_tests_steps.py, with a capability writer in supervision_world.py if needed. The deprecated r56 scenario is retired from the feature file. The researcher's questions are settled: a missing capability file is not guarantees, so the run is refused (decision 1 and the Implementation line); a probe next to an unaccepted scenario of a non-guarantees work-item stays refused (r56 literally). test_supervision.py and supervise_merge.py are dropped from the file set (no edit). No existing test breaks.
